item.title: Record-breaking diesel prices look set to push grocery bills even higher — and Thanksgiving is getting closer
item.description: Rising diesel prices have been a “silent killer” for Americans’ wallets — but they could get louder soon, as prices for the fuel continue to shatter records.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Keshner

item.title: Bond yields surge above 5% as Wall Street fears more Fed rate hikes
item.description: Stocks fall, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 retreating from record territory as bond yields suddenly jump.
item.dc:creator: Joy Wiltermuth
Isabel Wang

item.title: McDonald’s is making a historic bet on chicken — and AI — to bring back customers
item.description: Investors aren’t sold on plans to introduce new McNugget flavors, and an analyst recently noted that McDonald’s has struggled to break through on chicken-related innovation.
item.dc:creator: Bill Peters

item.title: Micron’s stock has become a ‘battleground’ as the AI narrative shifts
item.description: Investors have become more focused on the durability of memory-chip demand, but there are reasons to be optimistic on that front, a UBS analyst said.
item.dc:creator: Britney Nguyen

item.title: This test screens for 50 cancers — but whether Medicare and other health insurers will cover it hinges on FDA approval
item.description: Grail’s Galleri test looks for 50 cancers from a blood draw, but a major study failed to prove it could detect later-stage cancers.
item.dc:creator: Jaimy Lee
